ios.desc:
Cross-Platform Files & Folders Sharing.
No data upload required. No cloud or cables needed.

Designed for developers, power users, and privacy enthusiasts.

■ Two-way files & folders transfer between your iOS and Windows, Linux, etc. devices.

Seamlessly browse, stream, and manage iOS files and folders from Windows, Linux, macOS, etc.

No additional software, drivers, cloud services, or cables required.

■ Launch persistent background WebDAV servers.

Easily set up and run Class 1 WebDAV servers on iPhone & iPad, compatible with rclone, Cyberduck, Transmit, Finder, and others.

■ Run local HTTP servers to serve static HTML websites.

■ Run multiple servers at the same time and in the background.

The Pro version is a one-time purchase; no subscriptions. 

Built for power users who need flexibility without complexity.

Term of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: a 1MB iOS App: Background HTTP/WebDAV Servers, CrossPlatform File Share

quotes.text:
I wrote a minimal iOS app called PocketServer (~1MB in download size) that creates persistent local HTTP/WebDAV servers which can actually run in the background.

Functionalities:

- Serve a folder via WebDAV — browse/add/delete files from others devices on the same network.

- Host a static website or directory listing, accessible locally.

- Share files cross-platform on the same network, no app needed on the receiving side.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pocketserver-local-server/id6743850070?platform=iphone
